parties.petitioner: M/S B N Padmanabhaiah And Sons

summary: Suit for declaratory relief and possession by former students as representatives; challenge to maintainability, limitation, res judicata; earlier decree for permanent injunction in appellant's favour; High Court reversed appellate court, decreed suit; issues: locus standi, res judicata, title, forfeiture, adverse possession; subsequent declaratory suit not barred by res judicata due to different reliefs and parties; forfeiture in 1919; possession resumed by Government; appellant's title disputed; adverse possession claim over 60 years.
legal_provisions_cited: Annaimuthu Thevar (dead) by LRs v. Alagammal and others, (2005) 6 SCC 202
Kalyan Singh v. Chhoti and others
Anathulla Sudhakar v. P.Bucchi Reddy by LRs and others, (2008) 4 SCC 59
